messages:
noah: Sundial Systems pinged about a tiny "mini" EAP for their microserver (2xV100-equivalent). They want a short compatibility sweep and a marketplace "preview tile". NDA attached.

reena: nice. can you paste NDA? also what's the ask size?

noah: NDA: https://sundial.com/nda/redwood-sundial-eap-v1.pdf. Ask: 3-day run window, 500 embed batch, 256-token chat burst, and an availability check under constrained memory (16GB). They want an initial report for their engineering review.

omar: quick tech notes: microserver has older CUDA drivers; need our fallback kernel set (cuda-compat:v0.8). KV cache likely needs tuning for 16GB. I'll add a small memory pressure test.

kelsey: legal: redline incoming. main telemetry ask is partner wants raw logs for debugging (no). we'll limit to aggregates + hashes. I'll upload a redline by EOD. :bookmark_tabs:

partner-ops-bot: Sundial provided test creds and a partner repo: repo.sundial.net/redwood-preview. They requested we run harness from inside their VLAN.

infra-bot: Preflight note: image must be signed with redwood-preview:3098 and use env SUNDIAL_TELEMETRY=partner|off. Also disable outgoing telemetry to public buckets.

reena: timeline? if NDA signed Mon, we could run Tue-Wed and deliver Thurs. Small window but feasible.

omar: bench plan: 1) functional smoke (startup, model load) 2) perf suites: embeddings (batch=500), chat (256 tokens, concurrency=6), memory pressure sweep (step down mem by 2GB until OOM). Collect p50/p95/p99, OOM counts, GPU mem HWM, and CPU steal.

kelsey: redline uploaded: https://legal.internal/redlines/sundial-nda-redwood.json. Key: no PII, telemetry aggregated only, no raw outputs offsite. partner agrees to ephemeral creds only.

noah: great. can someone own the benchmark one-pager? need a simple table: tests, metrics, caveats. I'll draft but need sign-off.

omar: I'll own the numbers and thermal logs.

reena: i'll draft the marketplace blurb. propose: "Sundial microserver preview: early access run in partner lab; NDA required; lab metrics only; limited availability." legal to vet.

infra-bot: deploy snippet (staging):

```bash
# push signed staging image to partner registry
redwood-deploy --cluster staging-sundial --image redwood/sundial-preview:3098 \
  --kernels cuda-compat:v0.8 --env SUNDIAL_MODE=preview --sign
```

omar: small technical caution: their driver retries can inflate p95 under short bursts. run both 2-min bursts and a 15-min soak to show steady-state. include cooldowns.

kelsey: timeline confirm: NDA signed by Mon AM -> infra push Tue AM -> run Tue afternoon & Wed morning -> draft report Wed EOD -> marketplace tile Thurs. Everyone ok?

noah: +1. pinging Sundial to sign today.

partner-ops-bot: Created ticket RED-7810: Sundial mini EAP - NDA / signed image / bench. Assignee: noah. Due: 3098860000. :white_check_mark:

reena: i'll coordinate partner comms and request region constraints for the tile.

omar: I'll add the memory-pressure harness and post run IDs in the ticket.

kelsey: once report draft in ticket, legal will give final ok on wording.

noah: thanks all. i'll update here when NDA is signed and drop the schedule. :rocket:
